summary: I played the sunset bench (17:36 to 20:00) and Jump in with the camera menu in the sandbox, with screenshots. All of it works when played alone; the suite's bench, key card and jump-in camera failures did not reproduce. One visual weakness: the evening camera at the bench does not show the sun.

failures.what: The bench view in the evening does not show the sunset it is meant to watch
failures.steps: Skip to 17:36, wait ~40 s until Sprout sits on the lookout bench with friends, look at the follow camera
failures.expected: Camera behind the bench looking out to sea at the low sun (as in the author's media/s51 stills)
failures.actual: The camera is high on the land side looking down at Sprout and two friends; the sun and the sea path are not in view and the bench is hidden under them

failures.what: The suite's bench test ('still on the bench at 20:00') is flaky or too tight
failures.steps: Run the lookout test in the suite (fails), then alone or my own dusk test (passes)
failures.expected: Everyone is off the bench after 20:00
failures.actual: It failed once in the suite (Pickles still on the bench after 5 frames). In my runs everyone had left within 12 s. Releasing may need more than 5 frames after the clock jumps, or Pickles was only still walking.

failures.what: Waiting for the evening sitting is slow
failures.expected: A few seconds, like the other play tests
failures.actual: Takes up to ~115 s because walking to the bench and sitting takes that long in game time

failures.what: While jumped in, the 'follow' camera uses the :fixed chase rig, so the rig mode is not :follow
failures.steps: Start Jump in, pick Camera: orbit, then Camera: follow
failures.expected: Menu says follow and the view chases Sprout
failures.actual: The view does chase Sprout (checked by screenshot), but game.rig.mode is :fixed. The suite check 'follow while jumped in is no chase camera' failed on eye 9.5 m from Sprout and looking 4.8e-7 m off it; I could not see anything wrong there

tests_added: Sunset bench: at dusk (20:00) nobody stays on the bench, within 12 s
Jumped in: the camera menu switches orbit and follow, and follow keeps Sprout in view
